title: Bram and the Winter
author: Q. M. Ishikawa
blurb: Hazel Brightwater, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
